spec: Weekly 15-delta puts on 5% of XRP-NAV, convert at 0.35 delta; 25-delta calls on extra coins only.

iv.atm: 0.65 * 7d XRP realized vol + 0.35 * 30d XRP realized vol, times BTC DVOL/RV premium, times a small weekly term bump. Floored at 30%, capped at 250%.
iv.wing: ATM plus skew: puts add 6% * ((0.5-delta)/0.4)^1.35; calls add 10% times the same. 15-delta put is ATM + ~5 vol points.
iv.fill: Sold at the worse of Black-Scholes on (wing IV minus 2 vol points) and mid times (1 minus a tenor/delta half-spread). Not a Deribit XRP IV print.
iv.btcVrp: When BTC DVOL and 30d BTC RV exist, VRP = EMA10 of DVOL/RV, clipped 0.90–1.40. Else 1.12.
